messages:
Noah B: Hey all, quick question as I'm setting up my onboarding checklist in Notion: where's the right place to keep an "Onboarding Checklist" that the whole eng team can update?
Maya (DevEx): welcome Noah :wave: put it under Docs > eng > onboarding or Docs > templates > new-hires if it's a canonical template. For a team-editable checklist, move it into your team space (Docs > eng > <team>).
Noah B: I copied the "New Hire Checklist" template into my private space. How do I switch it to team-editable (so others can tick items)?
Maya (DevEx): Duplicate if you want to keep a personal copy, then Move -> select "eng / <team-name>". After moving: Share -> invite eng@redwood.com -> set to "Can edit". If Move is blocked you might see "You don't have permission to move this page".
Noah B: I'm getting that move error. It says "You don't have permission to relocate this page". Page id: b7a4d2.
Sam (Docs Ops): we can transfer ownership so history is preserved. Do you want Docs Ops to handle it? If yes I'll open a ticket and grant temporary duplicate rights.
Noah B: Yes please, I care about preserving comments and the task check history.
devex-bot: Ticket created DOC-1005: "Transfer: New Hire Checklist (b7a4d2) -> eng/<team-name>". Assignee: Docs Ops. https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-1005
Maya (DevEx): once DOC-1005 is complete, move the page property "Visibility" to Team and set the page icon/title to start with "onboard-" so it sorts in the space nav. We also recommend adding a page property `template-status` = candidate before promoting it to Templates.
Noah B: good to know. small follow-up: where's the canonical templates index so I can propose a small tweak to the checklist (add a line about 2FA setup)?
Maya (DevEx): Templates index: Docs > Templates > Team templates. To propose changes: copy the page into the Templates drafts area and open a PR in the templates tracker (link at top of the Templates page) or ping #devex with the draft link and the rationale.
Noah B: Thanks! One tiny nit: can someone confirm eng@redwood.com is the right group? sometimes I see eng@ and sometimes eng-team@
Sam (Docs Ops): eng@redwood.com is the canonical engineering group for docs permissions. eng-team@ is used only for calendar invites.
Noah B: perfect, closing loop. Appreciate the help :raised_hands:
